hypothesis: A frozen semantic evaluator may benefit from enforcing the logical correspondence between a proposition and its explicitly negated view, without treating agreement as independent evidence.
policy: One fixed arithmetic mean of original relation scores and negated-view scores with YES/NO swapped, MAYBE unchanged. No sweep or learned weight.
wrapper: It is not true that {complete original proposition}
scope: Explicitly declared historical propositions only, not unparsed user questions; consistent supplied-evidence entailment setting. Related views are not independent sources.
inputs: Same reused207development cases; no fresh or locked inputs
gate: Raw accuracy improvement>=.02 over frozen29; raw definitive coverage regression<=.02. No promotion from development.
calibration: Raw relation scores unqualified; old calibration cannot be applied to a changed policy.
resources: Local CPU2threads, no new cloud spend; at most207new negated model evaluations plus3parity checks. Run after35 to avoid competing CPU training.
selection: Single declared policy; not choose between wrapper or aggregation alternatives after seeing results.
